items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: I always hearken back to Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: I just can’t stomach most of the stuff I hear today. And I don’t understand it. And I always hearken back to Louis Armstrong, the boppers and this — what the hell song is it he does — “The Whiffinpoof Song.” He’s got a line in “The Whiffinpoof Song” about the boppers with the hey-de-hey and stuff. But I still don’t understand a lot of the people who are important in jazz some years back — Ornette Coleman. I mean God I’ll never forget I was at the jazz festival in Northern California, what the hell —
I think I know what you mean. Monterey.
